privacyPolicy.introP1: Liftech is an academic platform developed to assist companies in managing and monitoring machines and employees. This Privacy Policy explains what data is processed by the system, for what purposes it is used, and how it is protected.
privacyPolicy.introP2: By using Liftech, the user declares to be aware of the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
privacyPolicy.s1Intro: Liftech may process different categories of information, according to user profile and used features.
privacyPolicy.s1Sub1Text: For system access, authentication data such as business email and password may be used.
privacyPolicy.s1Sub2Intro: Administrators may register employees in the system. During this process, the following may be recorded:
privacyPolicy.s1Sub2Outro: This information is used to identify the employee and enable functionalities related to their activities in the system.
privacyPolicy.s1Sub3Intro: When registering a forklift, the system may store information such as:
s1Sub3Items: Hardware identification associated with the machine;
Information related to the use of the forklift.
privacyPolicy.s1Sub3Outro: The hardware used by Liftech does not have GPS and does not perform geographic tracking of the employee.
privacyPolicy.s2P1: Liftech may receive information from hardware installed on forklifts.
privacyPolicy.s2P2: The device was designed to identify certain events related to machine operation, including:
privacyPolicy.s2P3: This information is used to identify and record safety events related to forklift operation.
privacyPolicy.s2P4: The system can associate these events with the corresponding forklift, sector, employee operating the machine, and the event date and time.
privacyPolicy.s3P1: Liftech records information related to the use of machines by employees.
privacyPolicy.s3P2: This history can indicate which employee used a specific forklift, during which period, and for how long.
privacyPolicy.s3P3: These records allow administrators to track machine usage and exercise greater operational control.
privacyPolicy.s3P4: The system does not track the personal location of the employee.
privacyPolicy.s4P1: When the hardware identifies certain conditions during operation, Liftech can record a safety event.
privacyPolicy.s4P3: Events may be assigned different severity levels according to their nature. Currently, the system considers:
privacyPolicy.s4P4: Records may contain information such as event type, severity level, forklift involved, sector, employee, and date and time.
privacyPolicy.s4P5: Administrators have access to event and accident records for operational monitoring and management.
privacyPolicy.s5Intro: Data processed by Liftech may be used to:
s5Items: Allow user access to the system;
Identify and record accidents and safety events;
Associate events with respective machines and employees;
Promote greater control and safety in machine usage.
privacyPolicy.s5Outro: Data will not be used for purposes other than those related to system operation and objectives, unless required by legal obligations.
privacyPolicy.s6Intro: Access to information is defined according to the user profile.
privacyPolicy.s6AdminText: Administrators can manage branches, machines, and employees, as well as view usage histories and records of accidents and safety events.
privacyPolicy.s6EmployeeText: Employees have access to information related to their account and can consult their own machine usage history and activity information, according to available features.
privacyPolicy.s7P1: Data processed by Liftech is not shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacyPolicy.s7P2: Access to information is restricted to users authorized by the system, according to their respective permissions.
privacyPolicy.s7P3: Data may be disclosed when required by law or order of a competent authority.
privacyPolicy.s8P1: Data is stored in the database used by the system.
privacyPolicy.s8P2: Information will be kept for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy or while needed for service operation.
privacyPolicy.s8P3: When data is no longer necessary for these purposes, it may be deleted or anonymized, subject to applicable legal retention obligations.
privacyPolicy.s9P1: Liftech adopts security measures designed to protect data against unauthorized access, improper alteration, loss, or misuse.
privacyPolicy.s9P2: Access to features and information is controlled according to each user profile.
privacyPolicy.s9P3: Administrators have specific permissions for information management, while employees have access limited to their profile features.
privacyPolicy.s10P1: Access credentials are used to authenticate users in the system.
privacyPolicy.s10P2: Users are responsible for keeping credentials confidential and not sharing them with third parties.
privacyPolicy.s10P3: In case of suspected unauthorized access, the user must notify the responsible administrator.
privacyPolicy.s11P1: Currently, Liftech does not have a specific policy for cookies or behavioral analysis tools.
privacyPolicy.s11P2: If cookies or similar technologies are implemented in the future, this Privacy Policy may be updated to explain their purpose and usage.
privacyPolicy.s12P1: Users may request information regarding personal data processed by Liftech, subject to conditions and limits in applicable legislation.
privacyPolicy.s12P2: Rights provided under data protection laws include:
s12Items: Confirmation of the existence of processing;
Correction of incomplete or inaccurate information;
Request for information on data processing;
Request for deletion of data, when applicable.
privacyPolicy.s12P3: Requests regarding data should be directed to the administrator responsible for the organization.
privacyPolicy.s13P1: Employee-related data is used to enable identification and track their relationship with machines used in operations.
privacyPolicy.s13P2: Liftech can record which employee operated a forklift, during which period, and what safety events occurred during operation.
privacyPolicy.s13P3: This information is made available to administrators for management, monitoring, and safety purposes.
privacyPolicy.s13P4: The system does not use GPS to track employees personal locations.
privacyPolicy.s14P1: This Privacy Policy may be updated to reflect changes in Liftech features, data processing practices, or legal requirements.
privacyPolicy.s14P2: When relevant changes occur, the updated version will be made available in the system.
privacyPolicy.s14P3: The date indicated at the beginning represents the date of its last update.
privacyPolicy.s15P1: For questions, requests, or concerns regarding privacy and personal data processing, the user should contact the organization administrator.
privacyPolicy.footerDesc: Academic system for management, monitoring, and safety of machinery operations.
